text.en:
Barangays Agnocnoc, Bunsoran, Ferrol, Hinagoman, Tubigon and Claro M. Recto, all in the
Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and
constitute into a distinct and independent municipality which is hereby created to be known as the
Municipality of Ferrol without effecting in any manner the legal existence of the Municipality of Odiongan.
The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Ferrol.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the new Municipality of Ferrol.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Odiongan shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Ferrol until the municipal officials
of the said Municipality shall have been appointed by the President.
Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the regular
election for municipal officials, following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner
removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to
organize or to complete the government personnel of the Municipality of Ferrol shall be appointed as provided
for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new Municipality of Ferrol in
the obligations, fund, assets and other property of the Municipality of Ferrol shall be transferred by the
President to the newly created Municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or part of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
